sources.snippet: Diffusion Models This is an easy-to-understand implementation of diffusion models within 100 lines of code. Different from other implementations, this code doesn't use the lower-bound formulation for sampling and strictly follows Algorithm 1 from the DDPM paper, which makes it extremely short and easy to follow.
